scope: Definition-only logical/query/profile candidate for existing IF-STAFF-10,16,18; no new endpoint, staff grant, workflow mutation, provider, key creation or application implementation.
cause: process-fields.csv111-116 leaves allowlisted filters, bounded pagination, truthful result states and minimal operator summaries unresolved; SOF01 and the catalogue already require those reads.
authority: Current staff identity/session plus explicit route action, query scope, per-object/purpose/consent/assignment eligibility and output admission. Four content roles are not an operational inheritance ladder. Unknown/missing grants deny; this proposal maps no people/groups and grants no unassigned/self-assignment privilege.

filter.name: wing_key
filter.meaning: Optional published canonical wing restriction, never new queue authority.

routes.membership: Currently purpose-permitted durably admitted handoff requests in requested/queued state whose existing approved queue-visibility policy permits this actor to inspect the minimal row. Not unconsented transcripts or a rule granting operators all unassigned requests. Unknown request outcomes remain in their own reconciliation, not silently deleted by this list.

item.meaning: Own permitted handoff UUID, current record revision, immutable server record-creation UTC instant, canonical wing or explicit null when this admitted source has no wing. Filtered queries match only actual equal nonnull wings. recorded_at is record metadata, not exact arrival order, response time or SLA.

routes.details: IF-STAFF-11 remains separately authorized minimum context; list grants no transcript, acceptance, decline or assignment.

filter.name: origin
filter.meaning: Only the alert's existing parent operation family; current parent/query/purpose authority still applies.

routes.membership: Existing alert-class intents with an unresolved external outcome or recorded unsuccessful delivery still requiring an approved recovery/disposition, and currently lawful parent/operational purpose. Closed resolved alert work is not an exception. This does not define recovery commands, retry limits or parent business success.

item.meaning: Server-derived minimal read classifications of existing pending/unsuccessful alert work, not new stored workflow states. A classification cannot establish provider delivery or confirm/cancel the handoff/booking. No parent payload or provider response.

routes.details: IF-STAFF-17 recovery requires its own current action/object and unknown-effect guards; the list never dispatches/reconciles it.

filter.name: issue_class
filter.meaning: Minimal classification of already-recorded scoped exception; not a raw provider reason or customer lookup.

routes.membership: Already-recorded unresolved/held/escalated booking exceptions visible under current exception/lineage/query purpose. Resolved work is excluded. A current no-slot result or an unknown provider read alone cannot create an exception record or a business transition through GET.

item.meaning: Exception and own authorized lineage UUIDs, current exception revision, immutable exception-record creation UTC instant and closed read classification. Mapping of stored evidence to these classes must be explicit; unknown mapping causes unavailable, not guessed classification.

routes.details: IF-STAFF-19 disposition and IF-STAFF-07 authoritative reconciliation remain separate; list cannot verify email, invent occurrence/slot truth or erase duplicate/unknown evidence.

projectionRules.minimal: No name/email/organization/brief, transcript/message, consent/role history, staff directory/contact, raw provider/debug/error, bearer/CSRF, meeting URL, recovery command or arbitrary JSON payload is delivered.
projectionRules.metadata: UUID/positive revision and canonical UTC instant reuse existing value helpers. Each source needs explicit immutable recorded_at plus a unique immutable item identifier and current object revision; no field is taken from a visitor clock. Actual store/column/index and classification mappings need reviewed physical binding before implementation.
projectionRules.authorizationBeforePaging: Apply current route/query and row/purpose predicates before ordering, LIMIT, lookahead, membership and result counts. A denied row cannot appear through count/has_more, cursor or timing categories. Unknown permission/storage/purpose/classification is unavailable, not an excluded row or a success empty page.
projectionRules.outputFence: Compose one coherent page and row revisions from one admitted database observation. The complete output dependency set includes all returned rows; every unreturned eligible lookahead row used for has_more; current source objects of the incoming ceiling and after keys; and every source-derived ceiling/after key emitted in a next cursor. Deduplicate repeated objects. Recheck current staff session/action/query authority and every dependency's current object/purpose/consent/assignment and source-copy expiry fence at output admission immediately before first byte. Historic permission, a valid MAC and an unexpired navigation window do not authorize re-emission of a source key. If known dependency eligibility or a participating fence changes, send the generic page_changed/restart_view result without any partial page, shortened result, guessed has_more or replacement cursor. Unknown/missing authoritative fence/source state yields safe service_unavailable, not an empty result; current route/session/action denial stays uniform request_denied. Previously transmitted bytes cannot be recalled. Reads do not renew staff clocks, mark seen, mutate work, acquire assignment or dispatch reconciliation.

query.first: No query or a closed set of optional limit and the route's one allowlisted filter. limit is canonical ASCII decimal1..25 with no sign, leading zero, whitespace or coercion; default25. Parameter names/enum values are exact case-sensitive ASCII. Reject duplicates, aliases, unknown fields, empty values, bracket/array forms, percent/plus encodings and stray separators; no sort, offset, owner, tenant, raw ID, SQL or free-text filter.
query.continuation: Exactly one cursor parameter and nothing else. Route/filter/limit/scope position are bound by the current server's verified cursor; a caller cannot combine a cursor with new filters or limit.
query.transport: Same-origin HTTPS staff-cookie fetch, no JSON/request body, conditional/range fields, cross-origin CORS, JSONP, HTML/login/provider redirect or browser Bearer fallback. A present Origin must exactly match trusted configured origin; null/malformed/foreign denies. Missing Origin is not identity evidence. Available Fetch Metadata must say same-origin for these fetches; missing metadata never removes cookie/action/object guards. Staff business CSRF mutation rules remain separate; GET performs no business effect.

paging.order: Descending immutable (recorded_at,item_id) total order, where item_id is the handoff/intent/exception identifier. Apply row authority first. First page fixes the highest eligible key as ceiling; later pages use key<after and key<=ceiling. No OFFSET, arbitrary sort or locked/long-lived transaction across browser requests.
paging.observation: Each page is one live current database observation, not a frozen multi-page snapshot, complete export or claim that every matching row has been seen. Concurrent inserts/late commits, membership changes, corrections/deletions and authorization changes can affect later pages; refresh first page to observe current head. Never use a PostgreSQL sequence allocation as proof of commit order. Page end means no further currently eligible row under this page's query boundary at its observation, not no work anywhere or forever.
paging.lookahead: Within the same complete scoped observation fetch at most limit+1 eligible rows. Return at most limit rows; has_more is true only when lookahead establishes another eligible row. If true, a next cursor is present and the page contains limit rows; otherwise next_cursor is null. Empty items requires false/null. Do not return partial success on timeout, missing shard/source, authority uncertainty, mapping failure or output-fence change. The unreturned lookahead participates in the same current output fence; losing it before output cannot be hidden by returning has_more:false or a shortened success. See the complete dependency rule.
paging.result: One route-discriminated closed page with kind, items and page metadata {limit, has_more, next_cursor, consistency:live}. No total/matched/denied counts, scope inventory or hidden-row references. Exact response/request/error modules remain next wire work; no current schema assertion is made.
paging.client: Deliberate Open/Next/Refresh only, no background polling, automatic crawl/export or retry. Each page replaces the visible page rather than claiming an accumulated immutable collection. If a UI keeps still-permitted in-memory prior pages, deduplicate by item ID/current revision and label them last observed; fresh detail authorization is required before action. Selection/filter/navigation/auth epochs fence late responses and errors; current authority loss clears private pages. Cursor expiry/change preserves only still-permitted filters/work and offers deliberate first-page refresh; it does not end a task, discard an admitted operation or reset staff/session/retention clocks. Accessibility/timing treatment needs complete-process design review.
paging.dependencies: A continuation re-admits its incoming ceiling and after sources under current minimal-row inspection, route/filter membership and source-copy purpose/expiry; it cannot assume historical source metadata remains permissible. A known deleted/expired/revoked/no-longer-eligible anchor requires generic restart without re-emitting its key. Unknown source/fence state is unavailable. The at-most limit+1 eligible ordered rows and at-most two incoming anchor source lookups are distinct bounded logical observations, deduplicated to at most limit+3 source dependencies (28 at limit25); this is not a bound on database scan work or a selected index/query plan. All dependencies participate in one admitted coherent page/output-fence decision within the common deadline. No key metadata is retained server-side just to keep navigation alive.

cursorCandidate.method: Use a bounded stateless integrity-protected non-bearer bookmark rather than an unbounded server cursor store or a database transaction held between HTTP requests. It is not encrypted: include only record keys already permitted on the originating page, public route filter enums, limit and timing. No principal/session ID, grant, contact/content, secret, raw provider data or new source identity is exposed in payload. Originating-page permission alone is insufficient: incoming anchors and every reissued source key must still have current minimal-row disclosure and source-copy eligibility. The cursor is not independent historical evidence.
cursorCandidate.format: Propose q1.<payload>.<tag>, exactly three components. payload is canonical unpadded base64url of at most512 strict UTF-8 bytes; tag is canonical unpadded base64url of the full32-byte HMAC-SHA256,43 chars. Entire cursor at most768 ASCII chars; no padding/whitespace/noncanonical trailing bits. Closed payload: protocol1, filter (exact route allowlist or null), limit1..25, ceiling and after keys {recorded_at,item_id}, issued_at and expires_at. Exact representation/decoder/temporal module requires its own wire review.
cursorCandidate.binding: Authenticate a length-delimited domain-separated message containing fixed purpose hsd-operator-page-q1, trusted route ID, actual current server staff session identity, principal identity, current approved action/query-scope policy fence and exact decoded payload bytes. These trusted bindings are not supplied by the cursor. Verify current session/action before cursor interpretation; compare the full MAC in constant time. Per-row current authority is still separately checked, even with a valid bookmark. JWT rotation within the same eligible login session does not create a new bookmark grant or extend its life.
cursorCandidate.lifetime: First-page issued_at anchors a maximum600-second window; every descendant cursor retains that original issued_at/expires_at and ceiling/filter/limit. No GET, token rotation, retry or new page renews it. Require supported current trusted time, issued<=now<expires and expires-issued<=600sec; unknown time/fence/key denies rather than extending. Expiry is a navigation refresh condition, never a qualification/booking/retention timeout. The600seconds is only a maximum navigation window, never a new metadata-copy retention grant. Each bookmark and in-memory page is bounded by the earliest applicable source-copy expiry and current purpose. Before minting a descendant, recheck all incoming and outgoing key sources and the unreturned lookahead; retain original chain times rather than reissuing life. A known source expiry/revocation/membership loss requires restart; unknown authority/source-copy state is unavailable. No independently necessary historical-key purpose is selected or assumed.
cursorCandidate.failures: After current route admission, malformed/tampered/expired/wrong-session/wrong-route/changed-scope bookmarks all produce the same safe page_changed/restart_view outcome with no reason or payload echo. Cheap outer target/length/syntax refusals remain object independent. Never fall back to an unsigned cursor or reinterpret as an ID.
cursorCandidate.keys: Purpose-separated high-entropy protected server key with no JWT/CSRF/proof-key reuse; no key is created, requested, configured or logged by this definition. Key custody, distributed binding/fence and approved cryptographic implementation remain held. Rotation can invalidate old bookmarks and require restart rather than retaining an unbounded old-key set. Python's standard hmac primitive and constant-time comparison are candidates before adding a signing library; no production algorithm/library/runtime selection follows from this proposal.
cursorCandidate.privacy: Bookmarks remain linkable private query data despite no bearer power. Redact query values in gateway/access/audit/analytics/referrer diagnostics; no local/session storage, public links, search indices or saved browser history state. Approved minimum operational audit can record route/class/result without cursor or item payload. Returning a bookmark never authorizes the next read. Source keys and in-memory page copies cannot outlive their currently permitted source purpose/expiry; redact/discard on current loss and fence late replies. Do not persist bookmarks to evade source deletion or to enable a longer audit/navigation purpose. Any future separately necessary metadata purpose needs its own reviewed accepted binding.

resources.pool: Proposed single32-reader pool shared by these three routes from receive through auth/query/encoding/output/draining, no hidden queue and one admitted reader per eligible staff session. Refuse aggregate overload without private detail; only current authorized sessions may allocate context-keyed limiter state.
resources.rate: At most60 starts per rolling60 seconds per issued eligible staff session across all three routes/tabs/JWT rotations/workers; at most1024 live limiter keys, no unauthenticated selector keys or eviction/reset of active state. Retire only after rolling window and known work settlement. Manual client starts spaced at least one second;429 tells the next manual attempt to wait30sec. These are unmeasured initial targets, not an SLA, chosen workload or bought capacity.
resources.intake: Proposed request target<=1024bytes, decoded headers<=16384bytes including aggregate Cookie values<=8192, at most64 fields, header/framing receive<=5sec, no request content/type/encoding/transfer body. Trusted ingress owns actual consistent HTTP-version framing enforcement.
resources.execution: Proposed2sec authority/query/serialization deadline after admitted headers,5sec body-delivery deadline and10sec client observation deadline. No release of reservations on abort/timeout before known settlement; failure yields safe unavailable or closes incomplete transport, never a second result.
resources.output: Serialize an entire authorized JSON response before headers. Success<=32768 emitted UTF-8 bytes; fixed body errors<=1024; identity/no Content-Encoding, no-store and nosniff for every route-owned result, no ETag/Last-Modified/304/Set-Cookie/CSRF issuance. A future independently approved authentication transport rotation cannot count as list activity or extend session boundaries.

outcomes.200: page including a truthfully empty scoped complete page; no action grant or all-system completeness
outcomes.403: request_denied/check_access for unknown/invalid/expired staff session or missing current route/query/object disclosure authority; no private condition/existence reason. Reauthentication and any authentication challenge remain the separately reviewed staff identity boundary, not a redirect or credential fallback here.
outcomes.409: page_changed/restart_view for bookmark/fence/stale-page issues after route admission; no underlying reason. No silent filter widening.
outcomes.503: service_unavailable/refresh_view for incomplete/unknown authoritative query, output or resource-state result; not empty/complete
outcomes.otherTransport: Object-independent bodyless405/AllowGET,501,406,414 and431; bodylessHEAD refusal omits hypothetical GET Content-Length. Unexpected route-owned500 is fixedinternal_error/refresh_view without private diagnostics. Intermediary errors are observation failures, not queue/operation outcomes.

futureOracles: Wrong-role/admin-only/unmapped action and cross-scope rows cannot leak through items, count, lookahead, cursor or error.
Empty permitted query and unavailable/incomplete source differ; all rows and has_more derive from one coherent scoped observation.

Concurrent assignment/consent/permission or source-copy expiry change between lookup and output fences the whole page. Revoke only an unreturned lookahead: no denied has_more bit/cursor. Revoke/expire only an incoming ceiling/after source while other rows remain allowed: no forbidden key reissue or extension; unknown dependencies yield unavailable, never empty/partial success.
First/next pages use unique immutable order; late commits and membership changes are live observations, never a certified complete export; cursor descendants do not extend600sec.
Cursor byte tamper, wrong route/session, grant-scope change, noncanonical encoding, missing key/fence and expiry fail without payload/existence hints or unsafe fallback.
Reads do not mark seen, assign, accept/decline, dispatch/reconcile providers, renew idle/absolute access, consent or retention.
Three-route/two-tab/JWT-rotation limits share admission; slow/aborted/draining queries keep reservations and unknown accounting cannot become zero.
Authorized detail/mutation still rechecks current object/state/revision; alerts or list classification never establish booking/handoff/provider success.
HTTP/raw/byte/no-store/HEAD and source/purpose mappings need actual-boundary evidence after implementation; schema fixtures later prove representation only.

primarySupport.meaning: Per-request/action/object permission and deny-by-default guidance; no Hengshi role grant or chosen output shape.
READ COMMITTED commands can observe different committed snapshots; no cross-request immutable-snapshot claim. Documentation input, not database version selection or installation.
LIMIT needs a unique predictable ORDER BY; high OFFSET performs skipped work. Does not prescribe these scopes, cursor or limits.
HMAC is keyed integrity, not encryption. Candidate uses SHA256, not the historical document's example hashes.
Standard-library HMAC and constant-time comparison are candidates; installed/selected runtime and full compatibility graph remain separate.

acceptance: Requires independent security/architecture review, exact closed wire/HTTP/error and cursor representation, scoped data/dictionary/physical/policy bindings, workload/resource qualification, complete-process design/accessibility and integrated founder acceptance. No source field/grant, key custody, mutation, provider, exact stable stack, operational legality or actual runtime is adopted.

revision.meaning: Fence all output derivation and cursor source dependencies under existing current authority and source-copy expiry; no new retained metadata purpose.
